weapon.flames_of_zamorak.name: Flames of Zamorak
weapon.flames_of_zamorak.desc: Evolved fire spells. Pillars of Zamorak's fire burst up under enemies all around you; bosses and elites are burned three times more.
weapon.flames_of_zamorak.level.1.desc: Evolved from Fire Wave with Augury.

weapon.saradomin_strike.desc: Saradomin strikes random enemies around you.
weapon.saradomin_strike.level.4.desc: Strikes hit around the target too.
weapon.undead_grasp.name: Undead Grasp
weapon.undead_grasp.desc: Evolved Saradomin Strike. Undead hands burst out of the ground and hold what they grab.
weapon.undead_grasp.level.1.desc: Evolved from Saradomin Strike with the Book of the dead.
weapon.two_handed_sword.name: Two-handed sword
weapon.two_handed_sword.desc: A heavy sweep in front of you. Upgrades through the metals to dragon.

weapon.colossal_blade.name: Colossal blade
weapon.colossal_blade.desc: Evolved 2h sword. A huge sweep on both sides. Bosses and elites are hit again.
weapon.colossal_blade.level.1.desc: Evolved from the dragon 2h sword with Dizana's quiver.
weapon.shortbow.name: Shortbow
weapon.shortbow.desc: Shoots arrows at the nearest enemy. Upgrades through the woods to magic, the arrows through the metals.

weapon.shortbow.level.2.name: Oak shortbow

weapon.shortbow.level.6.name: Yew shortbow

weapon.shortbow.level.8.name: Magic shortbow
weapon.shortbow.level.8.desc: Faster; arrows pass through one more enemy.
weapon.dark_bow.name: Dark bow
weapon.dark_bow.desc: Evolved shortbow. Two heavy dragon arrows at a time, Descent of Dragons, that blow up where they hit.
weapon.dark_bow.level.1.name: Dark bow
weapon.dark_bow.level.1.desc: Evolved from the magic shortbow with Rigour.
weapon.dark_bow.level.2.name: Dark bow
weapon.dark_bow.level.3.name: Dark bow
weapon.throwing_axes.name: Throwing axes
weapon.throwing_axes.desc: Throws axes at the nearest enemy that bounce on from one to the next. Upgrades through the metals to dragon.
weapon.throwing_axes.level.1.name: Bronze thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.2.name: Iron thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.2.desc: Axes bounce on to one more enemy.
weapon.throwing_axes.level.3.name: Steel thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.4.name: Mithril thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.5.name: Adamant thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.5.desc: Axes bounce on to one more enemy.
weapon.throwing_axes.level.6.name: Rune thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.7.name: Dragon thrownaxe
weapon.throwing_axes.level.7.desc: Axes bounce on to two more enemies.
weapon.throwing_axes.level.8.name: Dragon thrownaxe
weapon.chain_hit_axes.name: Chain-hit axes
weapon.chain_hit_axes.desc: Evolved throwing axes. Morrigan's axes chain-hit through a crowd, bouncing on to up to nine more.
weapon.chain_hit_axes.level.1.name: Chain-hit axes
weapon.chain_hit_axes.level.1.desc: Evolved from dragon thrownaxes with the Tome of fire.
weapon.chain_hit_axes.level.2.name: Chain-hit axes
weapon.chain_hit_axes.level.3.name: Chain-hit axes
weapon.elemental_runes.name: Elemental runes
weapon.elemental_runes.desc: Runes circle you for a while, hitting whatever they pass and knocking it back.
weapon.elemental_runes.level.2.desc: A water rune joins the air rune.
weapon.elemental_runes.level.8.desc: They go round faster, for longer.
weapon.astral_runes.name: Astral runes
weapon.astral_runes.desc: Evolved elemental runes. Vengeance's runes circle you and never stop.
weapon.astral_runes.level.1.desc: Evolved from elemental runes with Vengeance.
weapon.scythe_of_vitur.name: Scythe of Vitur
weapon.scythe_of_vitur.desc: Sweeps a wide arc in front of you. Bosses and elites are hit three times.
weapon.holy_scythe_of_vitur.name: Holy Scythe of Vitur
weapon.holy_scythe_of_vitur.desc: Sweeps all the way round you. Bosses and elites are hit three times, and every sixth sweep is Holy Light, which heals you.
weapon.holy_scythe_of_vitur.special.name: Holy Light
weapon.sanguine_scythe.name: Sanguine Scythe of Vitur
weapon.sanguine_scythe.desc: Evolved Scythe of Vitur. A wider sweep. Bosses and elites are hit three times, and every fourth sweep is Blood Harvest, which heals you.
weapon.sanguine_scythe.level.1.desc: Evolved from the Scythe of Vitur with Chivalry.
weapon.sanguine_scythe.special.name: Blood Harvest
weapon.armadyl_godsword.name: Armadyl godsword
weapon.armadyl_godsword.desc: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is The Judgement, a huge hit.
weapon.armadyl_godsword.special.name: The Judgement
weapon.bandos_godsword.name: Bandos godsword
weapon.bandos_godsword.desc: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is Warstrike: what it hits takes 25% more damage for 10s.
weapon.bandos_godsword.special.name: Warstrike
weapon.saradomin_godsword.name: Saradomin godsword
weapon.saradomin_godsword.desc: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is Healing Blade: heals you by half the damage it does, up to 3.
weapon.saradomin_godsword.special.name: Healing Blade
weapon.zamorak_godsword.name: Zamorak godsword
weapon.zamorak_godsword.desc: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is Ice Cleave: what it hits is frozen in place.
weapon.zamorak_godsword.special.name: Ice Cleave
weapon.godsword.name: Godsword
weapon.godsword.desc: A heavy two-handed sweep. At level 2 you pick its hilt, and with it its special attack.
weapon.ancient_godsword.name: Ancient godsword
weapon.ancient_godsword.desc: Evolved godsword. Every third swing is Blood Sacrifice: it hits everything around you and heals you.
weapon.ancient_godsword.level.1.desc: Evolved from a godsword with Piety.
weapon.ancient_godsword.special.name: Blood Sacrifice
weapon.dragon_claws.name: Dragon claws
weapon.dragon_claws.desc: Four quick slashes at the closest enemy each time, the last the hardest.
weapon.dragon_claws.level.5.desc: +2 damage a slash; also slashes behind you. +0.2 knockback.
weapon.burning_claws.name: Burning claws
weapon.burning_claws.desc: Evolved Dragon claws. Four quick slashes each time, and every third set burns what it hits.
weapon.burning_claws.level.1.desc: Evolved from the Dragon claws with the Tome of fire.
weapon.burning_claws.special.name: Burning Slice
weapon.ivandis_flail.name: Ivandis flail
weapon.ivandis_flail.desc: Flails at the closest enemy. Vampyres and the undead are hit 50% harder.
weapon.ivandis_flail.level.4.desc: Flails a little faster and further.
weapon.blisterwood_flail.name: Blisterwood flail
weapon.blisterwood_flail.desc: Evolved Ivandis flail. Vampyres and the undead are hit 50% harder, and pass the hit on to three more of their kind nearby.
weapon.blisterwood_flail.level.1.desc: Evolved from the Ivandis flail with the Book of the dead.
weapon.osmumtens_fang.name: Osmumten's fang
weapon.osmumtens_fang.desc: Fast, precise stabs at the closest enemy. Bosses and elites are hit twice.
weapon.ghrazi_rapier.name: Ghrazi rapier
weapon.ghrazi_rapier.desc: The fastest stabs there are, at the closest enemy. Bosses and elites are hit twice.
weapon.keris_partisan.name: Keris partisan
weapon.keris_partisan.desc: Quick stabs at the closest enemy. Kalphites and scarabs take a third more.
weapon.keris_partisan_of_breaching.name: Keris partisan of breaching
weapon.keris_partisan_of_breaching.desc: Quick stabs that now and then find a gap in the shell for triple damage, far more often in kalphites and scarabs, which take a third more.
weapon.keris_partisan_of_corruption.name: Keris partisan of corruption
weapon.keris_partisan_of_corruption.desc: Quick stabs; kalphites and scarabs take a third more. Every sixth is Wrath of Amascut: what it hits takes 25% more from everything for 6 seconds.
weapon.keris_partisan_of_the_sun.name: Keris partisan of the sun
weapon.keris_partisan_of_the_sun.desc: Quick stabs; kalphites and scarabs take a third more. Each kill heals you, it hits a quarter harder below a quarter of your hitpoints, and every fortieth is Tumeken's Light: healed to full, and poison cured.
weapon.keris_partisan_of_amascut.name: Keris partisan of amascut
weapon.keris_partisan_of_amascut.desc: The jewels' powers in one, but Tumeken's Light: gaps in the shell for triple damage, Wrath of Amascut every sixth stab, a heal on each kill, and a quarter harder below a quarter of your hitpoints. Kalphites and scarabs take a third more.
weapon.tzhaar_ket_om.name: Tzhaar-ket-om
weapon.tzhaar_ket_om.desc: A slow, crushing sweep that knocks enemies far back. Every fourth swing is Quake: what it hits is stunned.
weapon.tzhaar_ket_om.special.name: Quake
weapon.dragon_warhammer.name: Dragon warhammer
weapon.dragon_warhammer.desc: Heavy blows at the closest enemy. Every third is Smash: what it hits takes 30% more damage for 8s.
weapon.dragon_warhammer.special.name: Smash
weapon.elder_maul.name: Elder maul
weapon.elder_maul.desc: Evolved Dragon warhammer. A heavy sweep. Every third is Shockwave: it hits everything around you, and they take 30% more damage for 8s.
weapon.elder_maul.level.1.desc: Evolved from the Dragon warhammer with Protect from Melee.
weapon.elder_maul.special.name: Shockwave
weapon.dinhs_bulwark.name: Dinh's bulwark
weapon.dinhs_bulwark.desc: A slow, heavy bash that hits everything around you, far out.
weapon.dinhs_blazing_bulwark.name: Dinh's blazing bulwark
weapon.dinhs_blazing_bulwark.desc: Evolved Dinh's bulwark. A slow bash all around you. Every third is Shield Bash: it reaches further and burns what it hits.
weapon.dinhs_blazing_bulwark.level.1.des: Evolved from Dinh's bulwark with Vengeance.
weapon.dual_macuahuitl.name: Dual macuahuitl
weapon.dual_macuahuitl.desc: Very fast slashes on both sides of you.
weapon.thunder_khopesh.name: Thunder khopesh
weapon.thunder_khopesh.desc: Quick slashes at the closest enemy. Every third is Thunderclap: it hits everything around you.
weapon.thunder_khopesh.special.name: Thunderclap
weapon.twisted_bow.name: Twisted bow
weapon.twisted_bow.desc: Shoots the toughest enemy in range. The more hitpoints it has, the harder it hits: up to +150% on bosses.
weapon.corrupted_twisted_bow.name: Corrupted twisted bow
weapon.corrupted_twisted_bow.desc: Evolved Twisted bow. Shoots the toughest enemy in range, up to +180% on bosses, and bosses and elites are hit again.
weapon.corrupted_twisted_bow.level.1.des: Evolved from the Twisted bow with Rigour.
weapon.bow_of_faerdhinen.name: Bow of Faerdhinen
weapon.bow_of_faerdhinen.desc: Fires crystal arrows at the nearest enemies that fly on through them.
weapon.bow_of_faerdhinen.level.4.desc: Arrows pass through two more enemies.
weapon.bow_of_faerdhinen.level.5.desc: Fires one more arrow, a little faster.
weapon.toxic_blowpipe.name: Toxic blowpipe
weapon.toxic_blowpipe.desc: Fires darts that leave venom in what they hit, hurting it every second. Goes for enemies without venom first, so it spreads.
weapon.toxic_blowpipe.level.2.desc: Steel darts. Stronger venom: 4 damage a second.
weapon.toxic_blowpipe.level.3.desc: Mithril darts. Fires one more dart.
weapon.toxic_blowpipe.level.5.desc: Dragon darts. Stronger venom that lasts longer.
weapon.dragon_hunter_crossbow.name: Dragon hunter crossbow
weapon.dragon_hunter_crossbow.desc: Fires heavy bolts at the nearest enemy that pass through it. Bosses and elites are hit again.
weapon.armadyl_crossbow.name: Armadyl crossbow
weapon.armadyl_crossbow.desc: Fires bolts at the nearest enemy that pass through it. One in five is enchanted: a ruby's takes a fifth of what's left of its hitpoints, a diamond's goes on through more, a dragonstone's burns.
weapon.armadyl_crossbow.level.3.desc: Mithril bolts. Fires one more bolt.
weapon.armadyl_crossbow.level.4.desc: Runite bolts. Fires a little faster.
weapon.crystal_bow.name: Crystal bow
weapon.crystal_bow.desc: Fires crystal arrows at the nearest enemy. Each splits into three where it first hits, flying on through the enemies around it.
weapon.corrupted_bow.name: Corrupted bow (perfected)
weapon.corrupted_bow.desc: Evolved crystal bow. Corrupted arrows split into five where they first hit, and each goes on through one more.
weapon.corrupted_bow.level.1.desc: Evolved from the crystal bow with the Graceful outfit.
weapon.eclipse_atlatl.name: Eclipse atlatl
weapon.eclipse_atlatl.desc: Throws darts that pass through enemies and set what they hit burning.
weapon.tumekens_shadow.name: Tumeken's shadow
weapon.tumekens_shadow.desc: Fires shadow blasts that splash. Triples your damage bonus for its hits.
weapon.tumekens_shadow.level.4.desc: Bigger splash; blasts pass through an enemy.
weapon.tumekens_shadow.level.5.desc: Casts one more blast, a little faster.
weapon.corrupted_tumekens_shadow.name: Corrupted tumeken's shadow
weapon.corrupted_tumekens_shadow.desc: Evolved Tumeken's shadow. Bigger blasts that pass through two enemies. 3.5x your damage bonus for its hits.
weapon.corrupted_tumekens_shadow.level.1: Evolved from Tumeken's shadow with Augury.
weapon.harmonised_nightmare_staff.name: Harmonised nightmare staff
weapon.harmonised_nightmare_staff.desc: Casts Fire Surge at the nearest enemy, quicker than any other staff.
Bigger splash; surges pass through an enemy.
weapon.eldritch_nightmare_staff.name: Eldritch nightmare staff
weapon.eldritch_nightmare_staff.desc: Evolved Harmonised nightmare staff. Each Fire Surge splits into three more where it first hits.
Evolved from the Harmonised nightmare staff with the Amulet of glory.
weapon.nightmare_staff.name: Nightmare staff
weapon.nightmare_staff.desc: The Nightmare's grasping claws come up out of the ground under enemies around you, every so often. Bosses and elites are grabbed twice more.
weapon.nightmare_staff.level.5.desc: The hands come a little more often.
weapon.volatile_nightmare_staff.name: Volatile Nightmare staff
weapon.volatile_nightmare_staff.desc: Casts Immolate at the toughest enemy in range: slow, and the bigger the target, the harder it burns.
weapon.inquisitors_mace.name: Inquisitor's mace
weapon.inquisitors_mace.desc: Crushing blows at the closest enemy, a quarter harder on the undead. Bosses and elites are hit again.
weapon.inquisitors_mace.level.5.desc: +6 damage; also swings behind you. +0.2 knockback.
weapon.sanguinesti_staff.name: Sanguinesti staff
weapon.sanguinesti_staff.desc: Casts blood blasts at the nearest enemy. One hit in six heals you for half its damage, up to 2 hitpoints.
weapon.sanguinesti_staff.level.4.desc: Faster; blasts pass through an enemy.
weapon.holy_sanguinesti_staff.name: Holy sanguinesti staff
weapon.holy_sanguinesti_staff.desc: Evolved Sanguinesti staff. Blood blasts that splash. One hit in four heals you for half its damage, up to 3 hitpoints.
weapon.holy_sanguinesti_staff.level.1.de: Evolved from the Sanguinesti staff with Rapid Heal.
weapon.kodai_wand.name: Kodai wand
weapon.kodai_wand.desc: Casts Water Surge at the nearest enemies, two at a time, with a splash.
weapon.crystal_staff.name: Crystal staff
weapon.crystal_staff.desc: Casts crystal spells at the nearest enemy. Starts basic and grows: attuned at level 4, perfected at 7.
weapon.crystal_staff.level.1.name: Crystal staff (basic)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.2.name: Crystal staff (basic)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.3.name: Crystal staff (basic)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.4.name: Crystal staff (attuned)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.5.name: Crystal staff (attuned)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.6.name: Crystal staff (attuned)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.7.name: Crystal staff (perfected)
weapon.crystal_staff.level.8.name: Crystal staff (perfected)
weapon.toktz_mej_tal.name: Toktz-mej-tal
weapon.toktz_mej_tal.desc: Pulses of obsidian heat around you that leave the ground burning for a while, hurting whatever walks through.
weapon.toktz_mej_tal.level.5.desc: +3 damage; the ground burns for longer.
weapon.blue_moon_spear.name: Blue moon spear
weapon.blue_moon_spear.desc: Ice crashes down on enemies around you, freezing them.
weapon.blue_moon_spear.level.5.desc: Strikes one more enemy, a little more often.

char.warrior.name: Warrior
char.warrior.desc: Starts with a bronze scimitar. Takes 1 less damage.
char.wizard.name: Wizard
char.wizard.desc: Starts with Fire Strike. Weapons are 5% faster.
char.ranger.name: Ranger
char.ranger.desc: Starts with bronze throwing knives. Moves 10% faster.
char.monk.name: Monk
char.monk.desc: Starts with Saradomin Strike. Weapons are 15% faster.
char.barbarian.name: Barbarian
char.barbarian.desc: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. 20% more hitpoints.
char.ancient_mage.name: Ancient mage
char.ancient_mage.desc: Starts with Ice Burst. Weapons cover 15% more area.
char.hunter.name: Hunter
char.hunter.desc: Starts with a shortbow. Picks things up from 50% further away.
char.rogue.name: Rogue
char.rogue.desc: Starts with bronze throwing knives. Finds 25% more coins and is luckier.
char.dragon_slayer.name: Dragon slayer
char.dragon_slayer.desc: Starts with a bronze scimitar. Hits 15% harder.
char.nomad.name: Nomad
char.nomad.desc: Starts with bronze throwing axes. Moves 5% faster and hits 10% harder.
char.menaphite.name: Menaphite
char.menaphite.desc: Starts with Smoke Burst. Gains 15% more experience.
char.seer.name: Seer
char.seer.desc: Starts with elemental runes. Effects last 25% longer.
char.berserker.name: Berserker
char.berserker.desc: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. Takes 0.5 less damage and hits back for 3.
char.obby_mauler.name: Obby mauler
char.obby_mauler.desc: Starts with a Tzhaar-ket-om. Hits 10% harder and has 10% more hitpoints.
char.pirate.name: Pirate
char.pirate.desc: Starts with bronze throwing knives. One more reroll a run, and 5% luckier.
char.pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
char.pyromancer.desc: Starts with Fire Strike. Comes back to life once a run, like a phoenix.
char.shayzien_soldier.name: Shayzien soldier
char.shayzien_soldier.desc: Starts with a bronze scimitar. Takes 0.5 less damage and heals 3 hitpoints a minute.
char.gladiator.name: Gladiator
char.gladiator.desc: Starts with a dual macuahuitl. Weapons are 10% faster and hit 5% harder.
char.javelineer.name: Javelineer
char.javelineer.desc: Starts with an eclipse atlatl. Projectiles fly 20% faster, and areas are 10% bigger.
char.vampyre_hunter.name: Vampyre hunter
char.vampyre_hunter.desc: Starts with the Ivandis flail. Hits bosses 25% harder.
char.werewolf.name: Werewolf
char.werewolf.desc: Starts with dragon claws. Heals off its hits now and then, and moves 5% faster.
char.godsword_knight.name: Godsword knight
char.godsword_knight.desc: Starts with a godsword, and picks its hilt. Takes 1 less damage, but weapons are 5% slower.
char.armadyl_ranger.name: Armadyl ranger
char.armadyl_ranger.desc: Starts with an Armadyl crossbow. Ranged weapons hit 10% harder, and projectiles fly 15% faster.
char.elf_archer.name: Elf archer
char.elf_archer.desc: Starts with a crystal bow. Moves 10% faster, and ranged weapons hit 5% harder.
char.gauntlet_runner.name: Gauntlet runner
char.gauntlet_runner.desc: Starts with a crystal staff, and 30% weaker, but hits 2% harder with every level, up to 50% harder at level 41.
char.infernal_champion.name: Infernal champion
char.infernal_champion.desc: Starts with a toxic blowpipe, the Inferno's favourite. Has 20% more hitpoints.
char.tzhaar_hur.name: TzHaar-Hur
char.tzhaar_hur.desc: Starts with a Toktz-mej-tal, the obsidian staff. Areas are 15% bigger.
char.scammer.name: Scammer
char.scammer.desc: Starts with bronze throwing knives. 50% more coins, and luckier. Trust them.
char.f2p_pker.name: F2P pker
char.f2p_pker.desc: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. Hits 10% harder and moves 5% faster.
char.durial321.name: Durial321
char.durial321.desc: Starts with the Abyssal whip, but has 30% less hitpoints. Everyone plays him in Falador.
char.lms_sweat.name: LMS sweat
char.lms_sweat.desc: Starts with Ice Burst. Weapons are 10% faster, and areas are 10% bigger.
char.castle_wars_veteran.name: Castle Wars veteran
char.castle_wars_veteran.desc: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. Bandages heal 3 hitpoints a minute, and has 10% more hitpoints.
char.void_knight.name: Void knight
char.void_knight.desc: Starts with a bronze scimitar, in the Void knight's equipment. Hits 10% harder.
char.inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
char.inquisitor.desc: Made for Phosani's Nightmare, and everyone plays them there, and nowhere else: starts with the Armadyl crossbow, moves 20% faster and has 20% more hitpoints.
char.saradominist.name: Saradominist
char.saradominist.desc: Made for Justiciar Zachariah, and everyone plays them there, and nowhere else: starts with Saradomin Strike, moves 20% faster, has 20% more hitpoints and heals 10 hitpoints a minute.
char.sands_delver.name: Sands Delver
char.sands_delver.desc: Made for Beneath Cursed Sands, and everyone plays them there, and nowhere else: starts with the Crystal bow, moves 20% faster, has 30% more hitpoints and heals 10 hitpoints a minute.
